title: Artsy Full Apt 15 min from Downtown
description:
This full apartment was newly built and designed for those with a modern taste.  With stained concrete floors throughout, stacked washer/dryer, and artsy decor, this cozy apartment will make you feel like you are home. 15 minutes from downtown.  The kitchen is equipped with everything you need to cook.  This apartment is a fully private apartment with separate entrance, using the entire bottom floor of a 3-story house.  Please let us know a little about yourself and who is travelling with you!

The space
Modern artsy decor. K-cups and Keurig provided. Fully stocked kitchen. New construction.

Guest access
Washer and dryer. Wireless internet. Full private apartment.

Other things to note
Absolutely NO smoking of any kind of the apartment. That includes vaping, pot, e-cigarettes and cigarettes.
